title: K2 Space closer
description: The last word before the footer: a 72px line centred in a tall black field (half the window width high on desktop), then one full-bleed photo (2:1 on desktop, tall on phones). The line reveals as it scrolls up and the photo settles from 115% and blurred to sharp.
notes: CSS only; without scroll-timeline support or under reduced motion everything simply shows
